Commentary.Commentary: That's it then from this game but there's still cricketing action left in the day! There is just one more game left before the focus turns to the semi-finals. The top two teams in Group B, England Women take on New Zealand Women in a cracking encounter to see which side seals the top spot in the group. That match begins at 10.30 pm IST (5 pm GMT) but our build-up will begin much sooner. Cheers!

Earlier in the game, Sune Luus won the toss and opted to bowl first which proved to be a brilliant decision as the experienced Shabnim Ismail got a wicket off the very first ball of the game and that set the tone for South Africa Women. They continued to get wickets regularly and it was Nadine de Klerk who was the pick of the bunch. The fielding and catching too was on point and the Sri Lanka Women batters had no chance at all. Only the skipper, Chamari Athapaththu kept on trying and got into double-figures before her side were bowled out for under 50 runs. With no scoreboard pressure, the South Africa Women openers played sensibly and took advantage of some poor bowling from the opposition to get the job done without breaking a sweat. Both teams are out of the competition but South Africa Women have something to show for it.

Sri Lanka Women bowlers needed a miracle of seismic proportions to pull off the win here but they failed to even get a single wicket. They looked deflated out in the middle and their bowlers were all over the place. Even the fielders made a couple of simple errors and all in all, they would just like to forget this game and head back home.

South Africa Women needed just 47 runs to win in 120 balls which is like a cake walk and their openers have done the job with ease. Tazmin Brits and Anne Bosch both got a bit of help from the opposition bowlers and fielders but never did they look like getting out and they have done the job in a hurry. The two put on a steady partnership and both of them scored almost similarly to notch up the win.

A very, very comfortable victory in the end for South Africa Women and they end their campaign on the right note as they get their first win. As for Sri Lanka Women, a nightmare of a tournament has ended in the worst way possible, with their most disappointing performance coming in the final game.

FOUR! Here are the winning runs for South Africa Women. A short ball, sliding down leg. Tazmin Brits stays back and pulls it behind square on the leg side for a fine boundary. SOUTH AFRICA WOMEN WIN THE GAME BY 10 WICKETS.
Touch short, outside off. Brits goes back and punches it down to long off. They take one more.
Floated and full, defended out solidly.
A single now as this is worked down to long off.
FOUR! Anne Bosch makes great connection yet again. It is tossed up, full and on off. Anne Bosch gets low and slogs it to deep square leg. One bounce and over the ropes.
On off, blocked out.
Full and on off. Tazmin Brits pushes it out for a quick single.

FOUR! Full toss and punished! Oshadi Ranasinghe spills a full toss, on middle and leg. Anne Bosch gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a cracking boundary. The fielder in the deep had no chance.
Oshadi Ranasinghe drags her length back, on off. Tazmin Brits goes back and pulls it to long on for one.
Tossed up, on off. Brits defends it on her front foot.
Fuller, on off, Bosch flicks it to mid-wicket and scampers across for one.
Looped up, on off, blocked it back to the bowler.
Short and on off, pushed to covers for one.
Full and on the pads, flicked away towards short fine leg where the fielder makes a brilliant diving stop.
On the pads, clipped away past square leg for a single.

FOUR! Nicely played. This is angling down leg, Tazmin Brits gets down on one knee and shuffles a bit across the stumps before paddling it very fine. The fielder from short fine leg gives the chase but the ball wins the race.
On middle and leg, Brits mistimes the drive towards wide mid on.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.

WIDE! A chance for stumping but the keeper is a bit too slow. This is drifted down the leg side, Tazmin Brits dances down the track and plays completely down the wrong line. The keeper has to fetch the ball from her left as Brits scampers back in. By the time the bails are whipped off, Brits is back in safely.
Starts off with a flatter delivery on leg stump, Tazmin Brits keeps it out off the back foot.
Change. Inoka Ranaweera comes into the attack now.
Around off, pushed away towards cover.
Around off, Anne Bosch heaves it away towards wide long on. The fielder from long on runs to her right and does well to stop the boundary. Two taken.
Tossed up on middle, this is played through mid on for a single.
Shorter and wider, thrashed away through covers for one.

Another poor misfield! A tad shorter and around off, Tazmin Brits plays it off the back foot and towards extra cover but the fielder over there lets it through and then has to chase it down. The batters do well to come back for the third.
Oshadi starts off with a flighted ball on middle, Bosch pushes it through mid on and rotates the strike.
Length, on off and pushed back towards the bowler.
WIDE! This is angled down the leg side and will be another extra.

Misfield and four! That's sloppy work from the fielder. Length ball, around the top of off, this is sweetly played towards extra cover but the fielder over there lets it through and the ball trickles away into the fence. Nothing going Sri Lanka Women's way.
On the pad, flicked away straight to mid-wicket.
A touch fuller and around off, this is played towards covers.

Risky single and a direct hit would have seen the end of Anne Bosch! Full and straight, pushed towards mid on and the batters set off for the run. The fielder over there is quick to throw the ball at the bowler's end but misses as Bosch dives in to kake her ground.

Good work in the deep. Too full and too wide to start with from Ama Kanchana. Anne Bosch leans in and creams it past the fielder at extra cover. The fielder at sweeper cover runs to her right and slides in to save two runs.
Ama Kanchana to share the new ball.
Around off, pushed away towards covers. 9 runs come off the first over.
Nicely bowled! Slows it up and flights it full, outside off. Tazmin Brits looks to drive but her bat face is closed and gets beaten past the inside edge.
Quicker and flatter, on off, this is punched off the back foot back towards the bowler.
WIDE! This is darted in down the leg side, Tazmin Brits leaves it alone and a wide is called.
Flatter and angling into leg stump, this is nudged away towards short fine leg for a single.
Around off, this is driven firmly towards extra cover.
Excellent running! This is dragged down on middle, Anne Bosch heaves it towards wide long on and the batters race back for two.

FIVE WIDES! This is a really poor start from Sugandika Kumari. Starts off with a floater but it is way down the leg side and the keeper has no chance of getting to it. The ball runs away into the fine leg fence.
